back: A named memory location that holds a value that can change while the program runs.
A named value set once that cannot change while the program runs, e.g. CONSTANT VatRate ← 0.15.
INTEGER, REAL, CHAR, STRING, BOOLEAN, DATE. Use STRING for numbers that are not calculated with, such as phone numbers.
DIV(a, b) is the whole-number quotient and MOD(a, b) the remainder: DIV(17, 5) = 3, MOD(17, 5) = 2. Python: // and %.
Brackets, then powers, then * / DIV MOD, then + -; equal precedence is worked left to right.
input() returns a string: convert with int() or float() before calculating.
Pseudocode string positions start at 1 (MID(s, 4, 3)); Python indexes start at 0 (s[3:6]).
A variable declared inside a routine; it exists and can be used only there.
A variable declared in the main program, outside any routine; it can be used anywhere in the program.
